svg.text: Toxiproxy packet loss on the Raft consensus port: retransmission must still converge

g.text: create the Raft and HTTP proxies
create the Raft and HTTP proxies
fail, so the leader's count is
measured and the peer must match
Two nodes, both addressed through Toxiproxy, with the Raft server list pointing at the proxy ports.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Database and schema are written through the leader, which Raft carries to every follower.
CREATE VERTEX TYPE User, Photo - EDGE TYPE HasUploaded, FriendOf, Likes - UNIQUE_HASH / FULL_TEXT / GEOSPATIAL
The baseline is established on a clean network.
limitData with a 5% toxicity drops a slice of the consensus traffic: minor damage the cluster should absorb.
Raft retransmits what is dropped; the wait is longer than usual but the target is still exact.
With the network healthy again, both nodes are asserted against the absolute total.
Four siblings raise the toxicity, make it one-way, or switch it on and off repeatedly.
moderatePacketLoss 20% - highPacketLoss 50% - directionalPacketLoss 30% one-way (3 nodes) - intermittentPacketLoss 25% x3
